# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the iterative RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle with retries, learning loop, and audit |
| IncrementalPlanner | incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment given current state |
| PythonLanguagePod | python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python—delegates generation to WorkerAgent and execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase using LLM prompts and playbook context |
| PodmanOrchestrator | podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer with security hash verification |
| PodmanRunner | podman_runner.py | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle and pulse execution |
| ImportFilter | import_filter.py | Scans generated code for forbidden imports and builtins |
| PlaybookManager | playbook_manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, deduplication, persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| Reflector | module.py (core/reflector) | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | module.py (core/curator) | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | module.py (core/generator) | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| LLMClient | llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers |
| BulletRetriever | retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| ContextScorer | context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context across multiple dimensions |
| ContextGraphRetriever | cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ pipeline: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| PlaybookRepository | repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search |
| AuditClient | client.py | Write-only audit client for emitting events |
| LocalAuditClient | local_client.py | Local SQiste audit client for development/test |
| AuditStore | store.py | Append-only audit store with hash chain integrity |
| PerformanceAggregator | performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| RedundancyPreChecker | redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| SimulationPod | simulation_pod.py | LanguagePod for PyBullet-backed simulation TDD |
| ModuleArchitect | module_architect.py | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| ProjectArchitect | project_architect.py | Decomposes project spec into module DAG |
| ProjectBuilder | project_builder.py | Drives module construction across dependency order |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as run_cycle.py
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Audit as LocalAuditClient
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_file)
    activate Runner
    loop For each cycle (max 12)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(...)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle
        Note over Cycle: RED phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(...)
        activate Worker
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test_files)
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        activate Container
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
        deactivate Container
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod
        alt RED aborted or error
            Note right of Cycle: Returns early with failure
        else RED passed (test fails correctly)
            Note over Cycle: Continue to GREEN
        end
        Note over Cycle: GREEN phase with retries
        loop Up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(...)
            activate Worker
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(impl_files)
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
            Container-->>Orchestrator: result
            deactivate Container
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
            deactivate Pod
            alt GREEN passed or abort
                Note right of Cycle: Exit retry loop
            else GREEN failed
                Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback for next attempt
            end
        end
        Note over Cycle: REFACTOR phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(...)
        activate Worker
        Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orhestrator: pulse(...)
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
        Container-->>Orhestrator: result
        deactivate Container
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod
        opt Learning loop (GREEN passed)
            Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflector
            Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput (delta bullets)
            deactivate Curator
            Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Cycle: added_bullets
            deactivate Playbook
        end
        Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(cycle events)
        activate Audit
        Audit-->>Cycle: done
        deactivate Audit
        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        activate Logger
        Logger-->>Cycle: done
        deactivate Logger
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle
        Runner->>Planner: record_test_written(...)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: ok
        deactivate Planner
        alt Cycle complete (planner decides) or max iterations
            Note left of Runner: Exit loop
        end
    end
    Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
```
